derived_from: tick and to-do exports and public profile page of a project-owned Mountain Project test account seeded 2026-11-11 (5 ticks, 3 to-dos), inspected offline; the raw exports are committed as connectors/mountain_project/__fixtures__/canary-*.csv because they carry no owner identifier
note: Route names, ids, URLs, locations, dates, notes and the profile are invented. The field set and the nullability seen on the real exports are preserved: Notes, Lead Style, Your Rating and Length empty on most rows, Your Stars -1 (null) when the owner gave none, several route types in one cell, a grade with a protection suffix, no avatar and no location on a profile that set none.
